Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Calumet County’s capital (county seat) is Appleton. Appleton is the seat of Outagamie County (and only extends partially into Calumet), while Calumet County’s seat is Chilton. This misidentification would have led to an incorrect final answer.
